correctness.rationale: Period-four histories are exactly sixteen positive values with four independent product-one constraints, dimension twelve, for p!=1. Log-linearization of the four rational recurrences gives one constant 20x20 matrix T along the period-four family. Cyclic Fourier decomposition factors all four degree-five characteristic polynomials, yielding semisimple return eigenvalues 1 (12) and p^2 (8) for every p>0, p!=1. The unit eigenspace is tangent to the fixed manifold; standard local contraction with summable center drift proves approach to some point of that manifold when p<1; an expanding normal eigenvalue gives instability when p>1. Standalone SymPy checker executed successfully and confirmed the monodromy polynomial and exact matrix identity.

value.rationale: The motivating paper establishes four-periodicity and directly identifies attractivity and stability as future work. The exact normal spectrum gives a full local answer for a mathematically natural one-parameter specialization, including the previously illustrated p=2 sign-mixed case, and sharply distinguishes attraction to a high-dimensional family from asymptotic stability of an individual orbit. This requires twenty-dimensional Floquet mode decomposition and is not merely a parameter substitution or a yes/no normalization check.
